scheme_name: National Awards For Outstanding Services In The Field Of Prevention Of Alcoholism And Substance (Drug) Abuse: Outstanding Achievement By An Individual
other_conditions: Nominee must be an Indian institution, organization or individual without discrimination on religion, race, sex, caste or creed
Nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized agency or person; self‑nominations are not accepted
Previous awardees are ineligible for the next three awards
For awareness‑campaign awards, the eligible entity must be a non‑educational institution or organization
Eligible organizations must have demonstrated innovative, cost‑effective, and visible awareness programmes, policies for a drug‑free workplace, and measurable impact in society
benefits_summary: Award includes a citation, memento and a cash prize of ₹2,00,000, along with travel and accommodation expenses for the awardee and one companion.
